note: 24 measured exhibit regions: 18 figure rows covering the printed numbers 1, 3-13 and 6 table rows covering 3, 5, 7, 8, 11, 12. Two printed tables are measured nowhere. Table 2 on p6 prints three rules 205 pt wide and Table 6 on p17 three rules 255 pt wide; `rule_table_regions` only groups rules that reach half the page width (306 pt on this 612 pt page), and each standalone rule is 1 pt tall, below the 25 pt minimum side, so both tables vanish. No bbox is invented for them. The full-page raster on p11 prints the caption-less 'LA 2028 Medal Table' with no figure or table number on the image, and the text layer never prints a caption for Figure 2 or Table 1, so neither number can be attached to it without inventing one; it is recorded as a table-as-figure row with no caption. The paper's numbering has other holes and they are printing facts, not measurement loss: Figure 2 is never printed, and Table 1, Table 4, Table 9 and Table 10 are never printed. Table 5's measured region stops at y303.6 — the header and three body rows — although the table body runs to its closing rule at y420.8, because `_absorb_rows` breaks at the printed ellipsis row at y313 that fails the two-numeric-cells test; the region is not widened here. p22's four panels are labelled '(a) Distribution of Gold Medals' and '(b) Distribution of Total Medals', wording reused from the Figure 3 histograms, while the panels themselves print 'Q-Q Plot of Residuals' and 'Residuals vs Fitted Values'. The prose on p15 cites Figure 4 for the variable m_c, but Figure 4 is the top-twenty ranking diagram on p12. Two algorithm listings (p9, p10) are excluded as not-an-exhibit and nine 693-path watermark blocks as background. Section numbering prints no section 2 or 3, and no 5.2, 6.3 or 6.4; the p11-p13 exhibits fall under 4.6 Results, the p15-p17 exhibits under 5.1, the p19 tables under 5.3 and the p22-p23 exhibits under 6.2 and 6.5. Two labels are kept as printed rather than tidied: the 4.6 heading line is printed '4.6 mmmmmmm mm m mmmm m mm m mmm' with the word Results on the following line, and 6.2 carries the same m-run after its title.
